## WHAT THIS IS

AI systems today operate with:
- no runtime governance
- no enforcement layer
- no audit trail
- no prompt security

AILeash adds a real-time control layer.

---

## SECURITY MODEL

1. Request enters system  
2. Threat analysis runs  
3. Policy engine evaluates  
4. Decision executed:
   - ALLOW
   - BLOCK
   - REDACT
   - ESCALATE  
5. Audit log stored
